scope: native Rust model of StartPresale amount cap, effective-point slope, funding goal, duration, and state amount on valid historical account layouts
qualification: Fresh deterministic local argument mutations on two historical transaction account layouts, using pinned current Founder and Fundraise ELFs. The Init-produced State is local; other account bytes come from later snapshots. Sigverify and blockhash checks are disabled for historical signers. Rust is an independently written behavioral slice, not original source, not an SBF build, and not full-handler equivalence. No live transaction was sent. Historical source calls postdate both pinned ProgramData deploy slots, but this does not establish present-day mainnet state for sampled accounts.
